intro: Move the sliders. Watch compound growth pull away from simple growth.

steps.explanation: With the same start, rate, and years, see how far apart the two bars land.
steps.label: Compare the two bars

steps.explanation: Stretch the years slider. The compound bar bends upward while the simple one crawls.
steps.label: Stretch the years

steps.explanation: Raise the starting amount. Compounding multiplies every extra dollar too.
steps.label: Raise the start

takeaways: Time matters more than the starting amount for compound growth.
The gap between simple and compound widens every single year.
Small regular top-ups each start compounding on their own.
title: Simple against compound, with your numbers
